notes.title: New Adventure
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sX9JzTATVAI;full][/previewyoutube]

Marla
The leader of a union consisting of Lucas' closest friends and assistants. A woman who maintains her hope until the last moment and has the courage to even give her life for this cause. She descends to the world with Lucas. She organizes the people living on the island and triggers a resistance against omega luma. She is really smart.

Lucas
The leader of the planet Vega, who received training from martial arts masters at a young age, is the one who will inherit his father's legacy. When Omega Luma engulfs the planet Vega in flames, Lucas lands on Earth with a spaceship, but the experiences he experiences cause him to lose his memory. You must reach the warrior spirit like in the old days, Lucas.

Omega Luma
One of the lords of darkness who came from the Luma lineage that lived in ancient times. Their ancestors caused disasters in the universe and with great luck our world remained free from these disasters. Omega Luma wants to reach Lucas' father's secret heritage and treasure and then kill Lucas. So will the Earth be destroyed like the planet Vega?

Arthur
He may look weak, but he is a true warrior. He has defeated many enemies one-on-one and is a master of using weapons. Lucas must get help from Arthur. Otherwise, disaster will be inevitable.

Andrew
His passion for the sea, which started at a young age, led him to an island under pirate rule. Andrew shows his wisdom to those around him with his experienced and calm nature. If he had received military training, he could even have become a general. Who knows?

BILGE
A strange and mysterious woman. The mushrooms she has been dealing with lately have an effect on her brain, and her skills and knowledge are extremely high. Although no one knows when she came to the island, she has a secret of her own.

NOAH
He is a funny and honest person. After working as a tourist guide in Europe, he falls into the hands of pirates during a trip and starts to serve them. His intelligent personality and ability to foresee events can help Lucas.

notes.title: Brand new adventure game from the creators of Call of Farming [New Game]
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299940/Omega_Luma__The_First_Battle/

Planet Vega is under fire..

A young man wakes up on a sky island belonging to our world by chance. His name is Lucas.. In this sky island where everything starts over again, we start a journey where we question ourselves, try to survive and meet new people. Our hopes and warrior spirit will accompany us..

Omega Luma comes to Earth from the middle of darkness and aims to destroy the last of all races like the planet Vega.. Lucas must reach the tree of life..

He must collect his memory and destroy the Omega Luma scourge..

But this is not an easy task at all.. We may even lose our closest friends in this cause..

Who knows?

notes.title: CALL OF FARMING IS NOW FREE!
notes.content:
You can play call of farming for free now.

Call of Farming: Together is coming soon!

In addition, it was designed as a system where you can play with your friends online with the survival module.

If you want, you can add Call of Farming: Together, which will be released very soon, to your wish list.

We wish you pleasant games

Mavi Game Studios.

notes.title: Camera problem Fixed.
notes.content:
Hello

We wish you good games.

notes.title: Call of Farming Music Update
notes.content:
Call of Farming Music Update

Call of farming received feedback from our players, stating that the music level could not be adjusted or turned off.
This problem has been eliminated and the music level can be increased or decreased.

We wish you a nice day.
